$comment: The reference stack of the live parity suite (tests/Gym.Tests.Parity), docs/plans/GYM_PARITY_INTEROP_TESTING.md section 3.
GymPythonSession reads every 'stack' entry from the embedded interpreter at [AssemblyInitialize] and fails the run on
a mismatch, because a live oracle on the wrong stack proves nothing; GYMNET_PARITY_ALLOW_STACK_DRIFT=1 downgrades the
mismatch to Inconclusive for local exploration. A value ending in '.*' matches by prefix: '3.12.*' accepts 3.12.12.
'gymnasium.commit' is the refs/Gymnasium checkout's HEAD; re-pinning the submodule means updating it here too
(port plan section 14.10). 'referencePlatform' is the runtime identifier whose results are authoritative (port plan
section 1.3): cells pinned to it report Inconclusive elsewhere instead of failing.
Keep the versions in step with tools/parity/requirements.txt.
